facts.fact: ISO's member record states that the Agence nationale de Normalisation, de Métrologie et du Contrôle Qualité (ANM) was established by Order 2017-031 of 23 January 2017 as a public institution under the Ministry of Industry, with the mandate to manage the national standardization system and implement the national certification system; it names no national standard on information technology or data.
